skill1: Recovers 3.52% of attack damage as HP, lasts for 15 sec.
Additionally recovers 16.5% of ATK damage as HP, lasts for 15 sec.
skill2: Gains immunity to Stun for 36.95 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 trigger: kit says 'Activates when the stage target appears' — a battle-start event with no matching TriggerDef. Modeled as `passive` (fires at t=0, which is what stage-target-appearance means at scope lock). The 15s duration on the 91.09% elemental-advantage buff therefore expires ~15s into the fight and never returns; a passive with a durationSec is a one-shot window, not a permanent buff.

⚑ SAME-CASTER-SLOT OVERWRITE RISK: skill1 (46.93%) and skill2 (91.09%) are both `elemAdvantageDamagePct` self-buffs from the SAME caster slot. The buff engine overwrites same-caster-slot entries, so the two are almost certainly NOT additive — the first Full Burst inside the opening 15s likely REPLACES the 91.09% with 46.93%, a net LOSS. Whether the kit intends them to stack (separate buff identities) is not derivable from the prose; measure a real fight before trusting either number.

⚑ Burst block 3 gate: 'if the skill user has immunity to Stun' is satisfied by skill2's own 36.95s immunity, so the +5.04s Full Burst extension is live only for roughly the first 37s of a 180s fight. No schema primitive expresses a self-status window, so this override applies the extension on EVERY burst cast — it OVER-CREDITS full-burst duration for the remaining ~143s. Recipe: add a self-status gate (targetStatus is enemy-only) or drop the block after the first rotation; measure FB duration late-fight to confirm.

⚑ fillGauge 98.56% is authored as `passive`, which fires once at setup — matching 'Activates 1 time(s) per battle'. If the engine re-evaluates passives, this would multiply the opening gauge; verify one burst-gauge fill event in the rotation log.

Lifesteal ('Recovers X% of attack damage as HP') has no StatKey and no HP pool at scope lock. Left unmodeled rather than encoded as `heal`: a `heal` effect would emit spurious recovery events that a teammate's on-recovery damage buff could consume, over-crediting the team. If a recovery-consumer teammate is ever paired with this unit, revisit.
partsDamagePct is inert at scope lock (partless boss) — kept for kit completeness per the schema note.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. D is a Wind SMG Attacker Burst III whose damage contribution is two elemental-advantage buffs plus a 426.24% burst nuke. The two elemental-advantage lines are the load-bearing modeling question (same stat, same caster slot — see caveats), and the burst's Full Burst Duration extension is gated on a self-status window the schema cannot express, so it is currently over-credited past ~37s. Lifesteal and stun immunity are deliberately unmodeled (no HP pool, no self-status primitive); the stun-immunity line is NOT decorative — it is the gate for the burst's third block.
